notes.text: The minor in the entertainment industry provides students interested in media content creation with a focused curriculum that will give them insight into the economic factors and professional practices that influence the creative process, and how they interact with social, historical, technical, and aesthetic elements. To be eligible for the entertainment industry minor, a student must be in good academic standing, have a declared major, and have completed CTCS 190g Introduction to Cinema or CTCS 191 Introduction to Television and Video with a C or better. To declare the minor, a student must submit a Change of Major/Minor form to Cinematic Arts Student Services, SCB 105.
